summary: Discussion of blood-related diseases and deficiency conditions

sections.title: Blood Diseases Chapter One
sections.originalText: 血痹者，身体不仁，风痹也。虚劳者，阴阳两虚也。
sections.translation: Blood impediment means the body lacks sensation, it is wind impediment. Deficiency taxation means both yin and yang are deficient.
sections.interpretation: This chapter distinguishes between blood impediment and deficiency conditions, providing diagnostic criteria.

keyConcepts.description: Conditions related to blood deficiency, stagnation, or heat in traditional Chinese medicine
